Identifying a faulted component in an RC series circuit may require voltage or resistance measurements.
INTRODUCTIONM
Voltage measurements determine if the circuit is working properly.
Resistance measurements isolate the fault to either the resistor or the capacitor.
Knowing which measurement to use will help you easily identify RC series circuit faults.
Let's begin the lesson on RC SERIES CIRCUIT TROUBLESHOOTING EXPERIMENT......
